PreInvocation.command: in=$(cat); k() { printf '%s' "$in" | plutil -extract "$1" raw -o - - 2>/dev/null | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' | cut -c1-64; }; curl -s -m 1 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:47750/agent -d '' -H @"$HOME/Library/Application Support/Nunsseop/notify-auth" -H "X-Session: $(k conversationId)" -H "X-Event: UserPromptSubmit" -H "X-Type: " -H "X-App: ${__CFBundleIdentifier}" -H "X-Herdr: ${HERDR_PANE_ID:+1}" -H "X-Muxy: ${MUXY_SESSION_ID}" -H "X-Cmux: ${CMUX_SURFACE_ID}" -H "X-Mux: ${TMUX:+1}${ZELLIJ:+1}${STY:+1}" -H "X-Wezterm: ${WEZTERM_PANE}" -H "X-Wezterm-Socket: ${WEZTERM_UNIX_SOCKET}" -H "X-Kitty: ${KITTY_WINDOW_ID}" -H "X-Kitty-Socket: ${KITTY_LISTEN_ON}" -H "X-Iterm: ${ITERM_SESSION_ID}" -H "X-Orca: ${ORCA_PANE_KEY}" -H "X-Pid: $PPID" -H 'X-Agent: agy' >/dev/null 2>&1; true

SessionStart.command: in=$(cat); k() { printf '%s' "$in" | plutil -extract "$1" raw -o - - 2>/dev/null | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' | cut -c1-64; }; curl -s -m 1 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:47750/agent -d '' -H @"$HOME/Library/Application Support/Nunsseop/notify-auth" -H "X-Session: $(k conversationId)" -H "X-Event: SessionStart" -H "X-Type: " -H "X-App: ${__CFBundleIdentifier}" -H "X-Herdr: ${HERDR_PANE_ID:+1}" -H "X-Muxy: ${MUXY_SESSION_ID}" -H "X-Cmux: ${CMUX_SURFACE_ID}" -H "X-Mux: ${TMUX:+1}${ZELLIJ:+1}${STY:+1}" -H "X-Wezterm: ${WEZTERM_PANE}" -H "X-Wezterm-Socket: ${WEZTERM_UNIX_SOCKET}" -H "X-Kitty: ${KITTY_WINDOW_ID}" -H "X-Kitty-Socket: ${KITTY_LISTEN_ON}" -H "X-Iterm: ${ITERM_SESSION_ID}" -H "X-Orca: ${ORCA_PANE_KEY}" -H "X-Pid: $PPID" -H 'X-Agent: agy' >/dev/null 2>&1; true

Stop.command: in=$(cat); k() { printf '%s' "$in" | plutil -extract "$1" raw -o - - 2>/dev/null | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' | cut -c1-64; }; if [ "$(k fullyIdle)" = true ]; then curl -s -m 1 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:47750/agent -d '' -H @"$HOME/Library/Application Support/Nunsseop/notify-auth" -H "X-Session: $(k conversationId)" -H "X-Event: Stop" -H "X-Type: " -H "X-App: ${__CFBundleIdentifier}" -H "X-Herdr: ${HERDR_PANE_ID:+1}" -H "X-Muxy: ${MUXY_SESSION_ID}" -H "X-Cmux: ${CMUX_SURFACE_ID}" -H "X-Mux: ${TMUX:+1}${ZELLIJ:+1}${STY:+1}" -H "X-Wezterm: ${WEZTERM_PANE}" -H "X-Wezterm-Socket: ${WEZTERM_UNIX_SOCKET}" -H "X-Kitty: ${KITTY_WINDOW_ID}" -H "X-Kitty-Socket: ${KITTY_LISTEN_ON}" -H "X-Iterm: ${ITERM_SESSION_ID}" -H "X-Orca: ${ORCA_PANE_KEY}" -H "X-Pid: $PPID" -H 'X-Agent: agy' >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; true

in=$(cat); k() { printf '%s' "$in" | plutil -extract "$1" raw -o - - 2>/dev/null | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' | cut -c1-64; }; if [ "$(k fullyIdle)" = true ]; then curl -s -m 2 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:47750/notify -H @"$HOME/Library/Application Support/Nunsseop/notify-auth" -H 'X-Title: Antigravity' -H "X-App: ${__CFBundleIdentifier}" --data-binary 'Finished' >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; true
